name: Invoice Extraction Agent
_note_on_connections: An automated scan of app/providers.py may report Google, OpenAI and Anthropic as three separate required connections. That is a misreading. This agent calls exactly ONE model provider per run, selected by the client. The provider list exists so clients can bring the vendor they already pay for.

options.label: Google Gemini
options.used_for: Model inference only. Gemini API via generativelanguage.googleapis.com.
options.scopes_note: This agent uses NO Google Workspace APIs. It does not read or send email, touch Calendar, Drive, Sheets or Tasks. Requesting those scopes would over-permission the client for no functional reason.

options.label: Ollama (self-hosted)
options.used_for: Local model inference. No credential required.

agent_owned_surfaces.note: This agent's own FastAPI service. It is not an external connection a client must link.

credential_handling.note: The key travels as a function argument through graph state. MULTI_TENANT=true disables the environment-variable fallback entirely, so a missing per-request key returns 401 rather than silently using a shared credential.

limitations: Produces an accounting import file only. Does not write to Xero, QuickBooks, or any accounting system via API.
Vision path for scanned documents is capped at 3 pages per file.
Handwritten invoices are not reliably supported.
Where an invoice's own arithmetic does not reconcile, values are returned as printed and flagged, not corrected.
